verdict.rationale: A live probe found https://developer.paypal.com/llms.txt returning HTTP 200 with a PayPal Developer Documentation index. A second probe found per-page markdown variants, such as /agent-ready/overview.md, also returning 200. The cart API reference is likewise published as .md pages on docs.paypal.ai, so an agent can ingest agent-oriented docs directly. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of how complete the llms.txt index is and how well agents actually use it, plus first-party documentation describing the agent-docs offering itself.
